jobs.description:
Make Nordic parcel logistics work better for customers and operations. Turn complex product needs into practical improvements.
PostNord is developing its Nordic parcel portfolio to create customer value, support profitable growth and harmonise services across markets. As a Nordic Product Specialist, you will play an important role in making these improvements work in practice within your assigned product area. You will combine your understanding of logistics and operational parcel flows with product expertise to improve processes, systems and services across the Nordics.The position offers the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues across functions and Nordic markets, turning complex requirements into clear specifications, reliable data and practical improvements.
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
The position offers a flexible hybrid workplace in a collaborative environment where colleagues support each other in reaching shared goals. Independent working methods are encouraged, alongside opportunities for professional development and career growth.
Benefits include:
The opportunity to work in a Nordic and flexible environment
Good insurance and occupational pension conditions
Wellness allowance and access to office gym and swimming pool, depending on office location
Employee benefits through PostNord´s employee foundation, PostNord Plus
Employment according to a collective agreement
 

Your Responsibilities
As a Nordic Product Specialist, you will turn complex requirements into clear specifications, reliable product data and practical implementation support. Using your product expertise and understanding of logistics operations, you will help improve products, streamline launches and simplify everyday work.
The role will focus on either C2C/Recommerce or International & Customs, including international parcel flows, import and export. Responsibilities will be adapted to the assigned product area, customer journeys and operational needs.
Your main responsibilities include:
Build expertise in product logic, services, terms, customer needs and logistics processes.
Support Product Managers with insights for roadmaps, lifecycle decisions, portfolio optimisation and product improvements. 
Maintain clear product specifications, rules, terms input, operational requirements and documentation.
Translate operational needs into system requirements in close collaboration with IT and Operations.
Ensure accurate, consistent product data across systems and channels, and make product knowledge accessible to stakeholders.
Support launches, changes, migrations and phase-outs through readiness checks, implementation follow-up, issue resolution and hypercare.
Coordinate implementation across Operations, IT, Customer Service, Commercial, Legal, CX, Pricing and Nordic markets.
Share product knowledge through guidance, internal communication and change support.
Capture and escalate local needs, implementation issues and post-launch feedback to support Nordic product development and prioritisation.

The Bigger Picture
The position is part of PostNord´s Nordic product organisation, where operational understanding and collaboration across different functions are essential to improving parcel services.

The Nordic Product Specialist reports to the relevant Manager Solutions Area and works closely with Product Managers and colleagues across functions and Nordic markets. The role provides insight into how logistics processes, systems and customer needs connect across the Nordic network.

The position can be based at one of PostNord´s main offices in Solna, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen. A hybrid working model applies, with three days per week at the office. Some travel within the Nordics is expected, particularly when building relationships and gaining a deeper understanding of operations.
 
Our Expectations
The role is suited to someone who is curious, business minded and practical in their approach, combining product expertise with analytical thinking and attention to detail. The ability to challenge unclear logic, simplify complexity and connect people across Nordic markets is important. Taking ownership and following through until changes work in practice will be key to succeeding in the position.

Relevant experience from logistics, preferably parcel logistics, or from a role involving operational logistics flows and process improvements is important. Suitable backgrounds may include product management, operations, customer service, sales support, process development or a comparable area.

Relevant skills and experience include:
Understanding of logistics operations, operational processes and how parcel flows connect with systems and services.
Ability to structure complex product information, documentation, requirements and master data.
Understanding of how products, operations, systems, channels and market implementation connect.
Analytical, solution oriented thinking that turns product knowledge into practical improvements.
Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills to move work forward across functions.
Good working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to analyse information and present findings clearly.
Fluency in spoken and written English and at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish.
 

Experience from a Nordic or matrix organisation, product launches, migrations or change initiatives involving different functions is an advantage. Relevant experience within international logistics and customs, or C2C/Recommerce, is also valuable depending on the assigned product area. A university or college degree is an advantage but not a requirement.
 
Interested?
We work with TNG in this recruitment process. If you are interested in this position, apply right now! The selection process is ongoing and the position can be filled before the last apply-date. If you have any questions, please contact the recruiter.

As Nordic Product Commercial Lead/T&C at PostNord, you turn product changes into commercial reality across the Nordics.
Turn Nordic product transformation into commercial reality. As Nordic Product Commercial Lead/T&C at PostNord, you create commercial product clarity and coordinate market readiness and implementation across markets. You connect product decisions and legal requirements with clear customer terms, commercial offers and practical go-to-market material. You will influence how product changes reach customers, strengthen Nordic collaboration and develop agents and digital tools that make product knowledge easier to access and apply. Based in Stockholm, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen, you join Nordic Parcel Product Management, where customer value, profitable growth and Nordic harmonisation are central.
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
See your contribution take shape in launches, migrations and everyday commercial execution. You will join a Nordic team, combining clear ownership with broad cross-functional collaboration and great development opportunities. In addition to fair employment conditions according to collective agreements, we offer:
We offer you a flexible hybrid workplace with a prestige-free environment where we as a team help each other to reach our goals. We encourage self-sufficient leadership for development and career opportunities. In addition to the benefits mentioned above, we offer:
Work in a Nordic and flexible environment
Good insurance and occupational pension conditions
Wellness allowance & access to office gym and swimming pool
Employee benefits through PostNord´s own employee foundation PostNord Plus
Employment according to a collective agreement.

Your Responsibilities
You will ensure that parcel product changes are translated into clear, accurate and aligned terms, customer-facing material and commercial implementation plans.
Nordic terms and conditions: Develop, maintain and coordinate Nordic terms and conditions and the process for parcel-product-related changes. Ensure structured planning, stakeholder input, documentation and implementation follow-up, in close collaboration with each country’s price and terms process.
Harmonised product content and communication: Ensure clear, consistent product rules, service descriptions, limitations and commercial conditions across Nordic markets, aligned with legal, product and value proposition decisions. Translate these into customer-facing descriptions, FAQs, sales support and launch material. Develop internal communication plans and content across agreed channels.
Governance and continuous improvement: Maintain governance and documentation for commercial product content and terms. Identify and resolve inconsistencies, unclear product logic, customer friction and documentation gaps. Use feedback from customers, markets, Sales and Customer Service to improve clarity and commercial product material.
Commercial planning and market readiness: Coordinate commercial planning and activation for selected projects, product adjustments, launches and migrations, covering stakeholder alignment, market implementation and follow-up.
Agents and digital support tools: Develop agents and digital tools that improve efficiency, quality and consistency in product, T&C and customer-facing work, helping commercial teams understand and apply product information and customer value.
You work closely with Product Managers, Pricing Leads, Value Proposition Leads, Legal, Sales, Customer Service, Digital and country organisations.

The Bigger Picture
Nordic Parcel Product Management owns and develops the Nordic parcel portfolio across markets. Here, transformation means turning complex customer and operational needs into clear portfolio choices and effective delivery. The role reports to the Manager Value Proposition & CX.
You can be based at our offices in Stockholm, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen. The hybrid arrangement means three days a week at the office and the option to work from home two days a week.
Selection is ongoing, so please apply as soon as possible. Certain positions may require a background check. If this becomes relevant, you will be informed in advance.
Our Expectations
Collaborative, structured and commercially minded, with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to support PostNord’s Nordic transformation.
Experience from product management, commercial documentation, terms and conditions, sales  enablement, customer communication, go-to-market work or a comparable field.
Excellent writing and communication skills, experience from translating complex product information into consistent terms and customer-facing and operational material. 
An analytical, detail-oriented approach to identifying unclear logic and finding practical solutions.
Proven ability to plan and deliver cross-functional initiatives, align senior stakeholders across countries and commercial teams, and manage governance, timelines, dependencies and follow-up to ensure timely, high-quality outcomes and continuous improvement.
Ability to create agents and tools that simplify work and help sales and commercial teams understand, explain and apply product, service and customer value information.
Fluency in spoken and written English and at least one Nordic language.
University degree, college degree, or equivalent higher education qualification.
Experience from a Nordic or matrix organisation, logistics, e-commerce, parcel products or regulated commercial environments is an advantage

You lead in line with PostNord’s leadership principles: Accountable, taking ownership of commercial clarity and execution plans; Brave, addressing uncertainty and misalignment early with facts and practical solutions; and Committed, staying focused on detail and delivery until full completion.
Interested?

With overall functional responsibility for Legal Support, Compliance, Legal M&A, Patents and Intellectual Property, you lead an international function supporting the business area and its divisions across multiple jurisdictions. Lead the Legal, Compliance and IP function, setting priorities and developing its structure, capabilities, senior professionals and ways of working.

Provide strategic leadership of Legal M&A activities across acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, investments and partnerships.

Your profile 
To succeed in this executive position, you bring the legal and leadership capability to operate confidently at senior management level. You provide clear, pragmatic, and commercially grounded legal guidance under time pressure, enabling rapid decisions while protecting the company’s interests, reputation, and compliance obligations. You demonstrate sound judgment, calm leadership, and the ability to balance legal risk with business objectives. The position calls for someone who can lead across legal disciplines while building strong collaboration across a complex international organization. 
Your background includes: 
Broad expertise in commercial legal matters, risk management and complex transactions. 
Strong understanding of compliance, integrity matters, investigations, patents and intellectual property. 
Ability to lead and develop senior professionals and multidisciplinary global legal functions. 
Experience working closely with executive management and a broad range of business and functional stakeholders.

jobs.occupation: Frontier Fellow - Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description:
The most valuable product development happens where the product meets reality. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work at that intersection: you turn AI agents into production-ready customer solutions and bring what you learn back into the product.
We call this role a Frontier Fellow: part senior engineer, part trusted technical advisor and part bridge between our customers, delivery teams and the HiveAI product team. HiveAI is Fellowmind's agent platform.
About the role
You belong to the HiveAI product organisation, but you will do much of your work alongside our implementation teams and customers.
Building one agent is easy now. Building agents a business can rely on every day is not. That's where you come in: you take on the hardest problems in our customer projects and solve them.
The job doesn't end when the solution works. You turn what you learn into HiveAI: when relevant, functionality, patterns and components built for one customer become reusable capabilities that help the next customer and everyone else.
What you will do
Fix the hard parts. Step in where agents meet real business systems, identity and users, and make them work. When shared components fall short, build your own.
Get AI agents into use, fast. Work with our delivery teams from the first customer conversation to go-live. Put a working first version in front of users within days.
Be a front runner. Help customers and Fellowmind teams make sound architecture decisions, challenge approaches that won't scale and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
Shape HiveAI. Share recurring requirements and architectural insights with the HiveAI development team.
Raise the bar for everyone. Share knowledge, patterns and best practices so implementation teams can deliver HiveAI successfully on their own.

What you might build
An agent that takes over a whole task, like handling supplier invoices or preparing quotes, and asks a person when a decision is needed.
An agent that works across ERP, CRM and the intranet on behalf of the person who asked.
A team of agents that share one business process, handing work to each other.
The tools, MCP servers and integrations they need.

Who are you?
You are an experienced engineer who enjoys being close to both the technology and the customer.
You can't stop building agents, and you want people to actually use them. You'd rather show something that works than a design document. You make good decisions without all the information, and you're as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code review.
You bring:
Coding agents such as GitHub Copilot as your everyday way of working, and the judgement to know which generated code will hold up in production.
At least 4 years of professional software development experience, with strong skills in at least one programming language and solid engineering habits: branches, pull requests and tests
Experience taking software into production, where security, reliability and performance matter.
Practical knowledge of AI models and agents: how they behave, what they cost, how to measure them with evals.
Working knowledge of Azure, Entra ID, On-Behalf-Of and least privilege.
Direct customer-facing experience, from technical discovery and workshops to architecture discussions and communication with senior stakeholders.
A good understanding of modern product development, including when customer-specific functionality should become a reusable product capability.

Nobody ticks every box. If you're strong in several of these and know where to find help for the rest, we'd like to hear from you.
What is HiveAI?
At Fellowmind, we're building HiveAI, a platform for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. It gives enterprises a secure and scalable foundation to move beyond isolated experiments, so AI becomes part of how the business operates.
At its core is the HiveAI Agent Platform, built on Microsoft Azure, which runs AI agents securely and at scale. Around it sits the HiveAI Agent Lifecycle, which helps organisations develop, manage and continuously improve their agents over time.
Why Fellowmind?
Fellowmind combines deep industry knowledge and personal guidance with Microsoft cloud technology across ERP, cloud infrastructure, data & AI, CRM, intranet and Modern Workplace. We are an international organisation with more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe.
Our culture is built around putting people at the heart of what we do. We value collaboration, personal responsibility, development and the freedom to find a sustainable balance between work and life.
The practicalities
Start: As soon as possible, and of course we'll take your notice period into account.
Scope: Full-time.
Location: This role can be based in Sweden, Denmark or the Netherlands, from one of our Fellowmind offices.
Travel: You will work with regional teams and customers across Fellowmind, so travel is a natural part of the role.
Language: Professional proficiency in English and the local language of your country of employment: Swedish, Danish or Dutch.
Process: We start with a screening interview, followed by in-depth interviews, assessments or case work, and reference checks.

If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
 Your future team
 Are you passionate about developing advanced vehicle technology while bringing people, technical solutions and teams together? At Volvo Group, you will have the opportunity to combine hands-on involvement in ADAS function development with a key role in supporting agile collaboration and successful engineering deliveries.
 You will join the Driver Support Functions team within Volvo Trucks Technology & Industrial Division in Gothenburg.  Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  
Additional experience that is valuable:

 Experience with Adaptive AUTOSAR or model-based development using MATLAB/Simulink.

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.
 
 
 
Role Summary 
This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden
 
 Join us at TRATON Group R&D and become part of a team that is shaping the way of handling new vehicle related legislation. We are responsible for overviewing and handling new legislation, coordinating the Technical Lobbyist network and making valid legislation available in the VW database Getex and also in the product structure OAS. We are part of the Domain Product Compliance within Modular Solutions.
As a member of the Regulatory Affairs section, you will play a key role in handling new vehicle legislation from a global perspective. Working across areas such as Active Safety & ADAS, Digital Product Compliance, Electrification and Circularity, you will coordinate legislation activities across regions and collaborate with stakeholders from R&D, Public Affairs, Product Planning and external organizations.
The role combines leading Regulatory Clusters, evaluating the impact of future legislation on products, supporting technical lobbying activities, and participating in international industry working groups related to vehicle legislation and compliance.
You will be active in some suitable external working groups preferably in the field of Active Safety. Most of our external working group participation is in the global vehicle industry association OICA. This is also very much depending on your back ground and experience. Other working group participation could be discussed depending on your background.

Job Responsibilities
·      Lead (Pilot) the Regulatory Cluster working group for Active Safety & ADAS and provide input to the legal roadmap within these areas.
·      Coordinate legislation-related activities with colleagues across Europe, Brazil, the US and China, including technical lobbyists, type approval engineers and subject matter experts.
·      Drive process development and ensure Regulatory Affairs responsibilities are integrated into TRATON One PDP and Regulatory Affairs processes.
·      Summarize Technical Lobbying Criticality and communicate relevant topics to TRATON Public Affairs when needed.
·      Participate in external technical lobbying working groups, particularly within OICA GEVA and ACEA, focusing on automated, autonomous and connected vehicle regulations, CSMS/SUMS and related legislative developments.
·      Monitor Active Safety and ADAS related regulations across Regulatory Clusters and working groups.
·      Stay informed about company strategy, technology developments and legislative trends to proactively support stakeholders.

Who You Are
 We believe you have:
·      Experience in regulatory affairs topics and participation in external technical lobbying forums.
·      Experience working within a product development process, with strong understanding of requirements management and Type Approval.
·      Ability to transform improvement ideas into practical implementation.
·      Experience evaluating and interpreting vehicle-related legislation.
·      A relevant Engineering degree or equivalent practical experience.
·      A structured way of working combined with high integrity and professionalism.
·      Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

 We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.
 
This Is Us
 We are a collaborative and skilled Regulatory Affairs section responsible for building the roadmap of upcoming legislation, identifying legal gaps, supporting efficient technical lobbying activities and ensuring vehicle-related legislation is available and accessible throughout TRATON R&D.
We work closely with TRATON Group R&D, our brands, TRATON Public Affairs and TRATON Product Planning. Our mission is to identify legal gaps early, enable proactive product development activities and contribute to the establishment of effective, data-driven vehicle legislation.
 
 Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry. 

TRATON Offers 
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
 
Application
 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 
 
 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-06. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
 
 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: 
 Magnus Jalkesten, Head of Regulatory Affairs, magnus.jalkesten@scania.com 
 
 
 We look forward to your application!
 
 This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group R&D

Company description:
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 
Job description: Financial Control & Accounting (FCA) is a global finance organization in Group Finance responsible for securing finance and tax compliance, accounting and financial reporting for most Divisions, Business Areas and Group Functions in Volvo Group. FCA also hosts our Finance Global Competence Center providing qualitative, process efficient, automated finance deliveries. We are a truly global organization with around 1400 highly professional colleagues in more than 50 countries, closely integrated with local business operations.
  
 Our mission is to secure accurate and timely financial reporting and compliance with the Volvo Group. We aspire to lead finance and compliance through excellence and innovation.
 We are now recruiting a Director FCA Global Tax Process Owner  
 
 FCA is responsible for tax compliance for a majority of Volvo Group’s legal entities. In the global context FCA operates in, it is important to secure strong tax compliance and efficient tax compliance processes that support Volvo Group. Regulatory developments and major finance and technology transformation initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA and MF2.0, create significant opportunities for further process development, automation and standardization across countries and regions.
  
 Therefore, we have established a new global process owner role with the responsibility to drive our tax compliance optimization agenda, coordinate standardization, digitalization, and efficiency of tax compliance processes within FCA.
  
 You will also directly lead a team of 2 global tax sub-process owners for Pillar 2 and Indirect taxes.
  
 In this role you will be working closely together with colleagues in the Group Tax department as well as with a network of colleagues working with tax compliance processes in FCA and other Volvo organizations. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape and drive our global tax process transformation agenda in a complex, fast-changing regulatory and technology environment.
 Key Responsibilities 
 
  Establish a global roadmap to drive efficiencies through process standardization and digitalization for tax compliance processes in FCA and Volvo Group, in cooperation with Group Tax and other key stakeholders.
 Anchor the roadmap and implementation plans with the Volvo Tax compliance governance bodies and within FCA.  
 Lead a global network of tax compliance experts in FCA to share information and to prepare implementation plans. 
 Collaborate with applicable functional teams to integrate tax compliance process requirements into the S/4Hana finance system
 Support the development of training materials and establish training sessions for end-users. Securing that process documentation is established when required
 Stay updated with the latest changes in tax laws 
  
 
 The position will require close cooperation with other internal functions in FCA and with other functions throughout the Group such as Group Tax, Group Accounting and Business organisations.

 The ideal candidate will have a solid overall knowledge of taxes including tax compliance processes for direct and indirect taxes.
  
 Leadership experiences including direct people leadership, functional and transformational leadership in a global cross-functional environment are considered as very valuable.

 Any questions about the position should be raised to Mats Pettersson through e-mail mats.pettersson@volvo.com or phone +46 765536213.

Allocation Controller

Welcome to a role where analysis meets business, customer focus, and commercial impact. As an Allocation Controller at Kappahl, you will play an important role in ensuring that the right products reach the right stores at the right time and in the right quantities. If you are analytical, business-oriented, and motivated by turning data into actions that drive sales and customer experience, we would love to hear from you.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to work in a central commercial role where your analysis directly influences product availability, customer experience and business results. You will join a collaborative environment with the opportunity to contribute both to daily performance and to the continued development of Allocation at Kappahl

The role

You will be part of our Allocation team and work closely with Buying, Planning, Retail, E-commerce and our market organizations. The role combines day-to-day allocation with forward-looking analysis and continuous development. You will have a clear mandate to identify commercial opportunities, recommend actions and follow up the results.

• Plan and execute product allocation across stores and online channels based on demand, sales performance and stock position.

• Analyze sales, availability, sell-through and stock health to identify risks and commercial opportunities.

• Develop and maintain store clusters and allocation parameters that reflect local demand and customer needs.

• Translate insights into clear recommendations and actions for relevant stakeholders.

• Monitor allocation KPIs and evaluate the impact of your decisions.

• Contribute to the development of allocation processes, tools and scalable, data-driven ways of working.

Are you interested?

This is a temporary position for one year due to leave of absence, based at our new head office in Mölndal, with a planned start date as soon as possible.

At Kappahl Group, we believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and has the opportunity to grow and succeed.

Ready to join us? Apply with your CV today – no personal letter is needed. We review applications continuously, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than November 30th 2026. We look forward to hearing from you.

Your profile

You have a relevant university degree, or equivalent professional experience, within Economics, Business Administration, Supply Chain or a related field. Previous experience from allocation, merchandise planning, demand planning, business analysis, supply chain or another analytical retail role is valuable.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with large data sets in Excel.

• The ability to connect detailed analysis with customer needs and commercial outcomes.

• Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

• Experience with allocation or forecasting tools, clustering methods or BI solutions is an advantage.

• Curiosity about retail, customer behavior, digital development, data analytics and AI.

Who you are

You are analytical, proactive and solution-oriented. You take ownership, communicate clearly and enjoy turning insights into measurable actions. You enjoy collaboration and build strong relationships across functions and markets, and you are comfortable moving between strategic discussions, analytical problem-solving and operational priorities. You have a strong end-to-end perspective and understand how decisions and activities in one part of the business impact the wider value chain, enabling you to identify dependencies and drive outcomes across the entire flow. Most importantly, you recognize yourself in Kappahl’s values: Inclusive, Courageous and Joyful.

The Kappahl Group is a leading fashion chain in the Nordics, with around 350 Kappahl and Newbie stores across Sweden, Norway, Finland, Iceland, Poland and the UK, as well as online sales in more than 20 markets throughout Europe and Asia. Founded in 1953, the Group has grown into an international fashion business with profitable and sustainable growth at the heart of its strategy.

We want to make a difference in the fashion world and to lead the way by always keeping our promises: taking care of the world around us and minimizing the environmental impact for each garment. And at the same time fulfil our employee promise "We promise you the right to always be yourself - a place to belong”. The Kappahl team consists of some 4,000 colleagues in eight countries, all with different backgrounds, ages, skills and styles. Our common motivation is to create a responsible world of fashion and offer fashion to a wide variety of people and lifestyles. A responsible fashion that feels right, for the bearer and for the world we live in. Today, more than 99% of the products are made of certified or licensed materials. Our overall climate goal is to halve the value chain's absolute climate emissions by 2032 and to have 100% traceability from fibre to finished garment in 2026. We also have a goal that 50% of the range is produced for a circular economy in 2026.

More information at kappahl.com.

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description:We’re looking for a Product Owner – AI & Test Engineering to join our SW Platform organization. We’re responsible for the machine platform that Epiroc’s mining and construction equipment runs on.
 In this role, AI is at the heart of what you do. You’ll help shape how software developers across all of Epiroc use AI in their daily work, and how AI changes the way we test and verify our software.
 Are you curious about how AI is changing software development? Do you enjoy collaborating with people across teams and helping turn needs into clear priorities? Would you like to help build something new from the start, with an impact across the whole company? Then we’d love to hear from you.
 A stream in the making
 AI & Test Engineering is a new product stream in our platform organisation. The teams are being built right now, and their setup, size and exact scope aren’t finalised yet. As Product Owner, you’ll have a real opportunity to influence how the stream takes shape, together with the teams, your manager and the Chief Product Owner.
 Your mission
 As Product Owner you’re responsible for the AI & Test Engineering product stream, where AI is the main focus. The stream is planned to cover two areas:
  AI Software Factory: exploring and introducing AI-supported, agentic ways of working across the software development lifecycle, for all software developers at Epiroc.
 AI-driven Test & Integration: using AI to rethink how we test and integrate platform software, together with test frameworks, simulation, a software-defined lab and system testing.
  
You connect the teams with their stakeholders. For the AI Software Factory, these are software developers and development teams across Epiroc’s divisions and sites. For Test & Integration, they are mainly the internal teams that develop and deliver on the platform.
 You’re responsible for the product backlog in Jira and the roadmap. By listening to stakeholders and understanding their needs, you help translate them into clear epics and user stories and support the teams in focusing on what creates the most value.
 You keep up with how AI in software development is evolving and help turn new possibilities into practical value for developers and testers.
 You work closely with the Scrum Masters and Tech Leads, collaborate with our architects and work closely with the Chief Product Owner on the overall platform roadmap. You also take part in cross-team planning together with the other product streams. You’ll report to a team manager in the SW Platform organization and be part of a supportive team where knowledge sharing and learning are encouraged.
Profile description:Your profile
  You have experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role, for example product manager, test lead, technical project lead or requirements owner, in a software development environment.
 You have a genuine interest in AI and how it can support software development and testing, and you may already use AI tools in your own work.
 You’re familiar with agile ways of working such as Scrum and with tools like Jira.
 You enjoy working with a broad range of stakeholders and helping new ways of working spread across an organization.
 It’s a plus if you have experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development, AI in testing, test automation, CI/CD or simulation.
 You speak Swedish and you’re fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  
As a person, you’re curious, structured, communicative and collaborative. You’re comfortable when not everything is decided yet, and you enjoy helping to create structure together with others. You build trusting relationships with stakeholders, help the teams find focus and like to keep learning.
 We know that great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this role sounds interesting, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds and believe diverse teams build better products.
 Location

jobs.description:
The Education Office (EdO) is one of SSE’s Professional Services units and consists of around 58 colleagues. As a central part of the SSE journey, we support and develop key academic services for students and stakeholders across our BSc, MSc, and PhD programs. Our work spans assessment, program management, scholarships, international collaborations, academic support, central course and exam coordination, as well as degrees and certificates.
We offer you
A diverse role at one of the top business schools in Europe with ambitious students and staff in a dynamic, academic environment. This role is ideal for a highly organized, people-oriented person who enjoys complex processes.
The role
We are looking for Admissions coordinator for our BSc programs. The successful candidate will belong to a team of Admissions & Program management at Education Office, reporting to Group Manager of that team.
Your tasks include, but are not limited to:
Coordinating application and admissions process for the BSc programs, ensuring an efficient, accurate and applicant-focused process.
Assessing applications, including eligibility, qualifications and supporting documentation, and participating actively in the selection of candidates.
Guiding prospective students and applicants regarding SSE, the BSc programs, admissions requirements and the application process.
Collaborating with faculty, and other internal and external stakeholders involved in admissions.
Contributing to recruitment and conversion activities for prospective and admitted students, including information sessions, events and other applicant-facing activities.
Supporting the Program Manager for the BSc in Business & Economics with diverse program-related tasks and activities, in accordance with the agreed division of responsibilities and based on the needs of the program.
Contributing to the continuous development of admissions processes, systems and ways of working, including the use of digital tools and AI where relevant.
Working in a dynamic organization where priorities, processes and responsibilities may evolve. You should therefore be comfortable adapting to change, taking on new tasks and contributing to developing new ways of working.
Occasional travel and participation in events outside regular office activities may occur.

Your profile
As Admissions Coordinator, you will be coordinating admissions process and processing applications and enquiries, often within fixed deadlines. You therefore need to be structured, detail-oriented and comfortable taking responsibility for processes from start to finish. You are proactive, flexible and able to prioritize while maintaining a high level of accuracy and service.
At the same time, admissions process is highly collaborative, and you enjoy working closely with colleagues, faculty and other stakeholders. The position involves contact with prospective students and applicants. You therefore have strong interpersonal and communication skills and can explain sometimes complex admissions requirements in a clear, professional and service-minded way. You are also comfortable handling challenging cases and communicating decisions consistently and respectfully. You are comfortable interpreting admissions requirements, assessing applicants and documentation against established criteria, and applying rules and procedures consistently.
Qualifications:
An academic education
Experience of, or a strong understanding of, admissions processes within Swedish higher education.
Experience of working with Swedish and international high school qualifications
Swedish and English, both spoken and written.
An interest in how generative AI and digital tools can support efficient and high-quality admissions processes.

Meritorious:
Previous experience working with admissions in Swedish higher education, particularly BSc admissions.
International experience or previous experience working in an international environment is an asset.
Good knowledge of Swedish higher-education admissions processes, eligibility requirements, merit rating and selection principles.
Experience assessing Swedish and international upper-secondary qualifications and supporting documentation.
Previous experience working in NyA and/or Ladok, or other systems used in higher-education admissions.
Previous experience working with CRM or application-management systems.

Other
This is a permanent position of 100% with an initial probationary period of six months. Start preferably in January or according to agreement. We encourage you to apply promptly as we are actively reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.
Please be aware that we conduct background checks on final candidates for this position.

Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura!
Our AI Lab builds the shared platform that teams across Coretura use to develop and run AI products safely and reliably. We're looking for a senior software engineer to help design, build and run it.
What you’ll do
You will work with the AI Lab to set the platform's technical direction, and take on a large share of the hands-on work yourself. Together, you'll build the platform that gives teams access to AI models across providers, manages and retrieves the data their AI products rely on, and provides the harnesses agents are built and run in. You'll also build agents yourself, and the observability that shows whether an AI product is giving the right answers, not just whether it's running.
Beyond that, your work will include:

Security and safety by level: controls and evaluations that scale with how autonomous an AI system is and how safety-critical its use is, from everyday AI tools to autonomous agents, with prompt injection defences built in. The higher the level, the more a system has to prove before release and the more closely it's monitored once live. You'll build this together with our Security Hub.

Cost and resilience: usage metering built into the platform so teams can see what their AI products consume, and recovery tested for each AI product as a whole (model, knowledge base, prompts and tool integrations), not just the servers it runs on.

AI assets as code: prompts, agent definitions, model versions and evaluation datasets, versioned and released through automated pipelines. They change often and any change can shift how a product behaves, so every change is automatically tested, evaluated and traceable before it ships.

Build to discover, then share what you learn. When we need to know whether an approach works, you build a working version, then use it to help colleagues across Coretura understand what works, what doesn't and why. As a senior engineer, you'll combine those findings with your own experience to help set where the platform goes next. You'll use AI coding agents in your own daily work and help other engineers adopt them safely. You'll also review designs and code, mentor the engineers around you, and hand over ownership of components as they're ready for it.
You'll report to the AI Lab Lead and work closely with our Digital Architect and the teams behind our developer and data platforms.

A solid background in software engineering, but we care far more about what you've done than how long you've been doing it. You've owned a production system end to end, including its roadmap, incidents and costs, and you've handed parts of it over to other engineers along the way.
You're comfortable with:

Using AI coding agents as a normal part of how you write code, with work you can show for it

Building AI applications that people can rely on: agents, retrieval (RAG), model APIs and gateways, along with the evaluations that show they behave as intended

Defining cloud infrastructure in code and shipping through CI/CD as part of how you build software, with the observability to see how it behaves once it's running

Practical security, from least privilege and secrets management to prompt injection defences

Writing well-tested, maintainable code in whatever language the problem calls for, and picking up a new one when you need to

You look for more efficient ways to build and run things, bring structure to an unclear situation without locking it down too early, and can explain a trade-off so that engineers, security and leadership all understand it. Fluent English is a must.
Why Coretura?
We're a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, building a shared software platform for the next generation of commercial vehicles. We're a young company with very little legacy to work around, backed by two of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers.
The AI platform serves teams across the company, so your work will directly affect how they build and ship software.
If this sounds like the work you want to do, we look forward to your application.

About the Center for wellbeing, welfare and happiness and research area
Wellbeing research examines how people experience and evaluate their lives, what enables them to thrive, and how individuals, organizations and societies can contribute to better lives. The field brings together perspectives from psychology, economics and behavioural science to understand different dimensions of wellbeing, including happiness, meaning in life and psychological richness. At the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness (CWWH), we connect these questions to the development of knowledge that can inform policy and practice.
A central methodological challenge is how to capture the richness of people’s experiences through reliable and valid measures. Advances in natural language processing and large language models offer opportunities to complement traditional rating scales with systematic analyses of people’s own descriptions of their lives, emotions and experiences. This research combines wellbeing science, psychometrics and computational methods to investigate what language-based assessments can reveal about wellbeing, how they relate to established measures, and how they can capture differences between people and changes over time. The position will contribute to developing and validating these approaches, with relevance to the center’s research in Sweden and across countries.
The role
The postdoc will develop an independent research line on the measurement of wellbeing beyond traditional rating scales, with a focus on natural language (open-ended responses, text and speech) analyzed with computational methods, including large language models.
The postdoc will contribute to the center's work on wellbeing in Sweden and across nations, co-author with center researchers, and connect CWWH to international collaborators and funding opportunities. The role also includes active participation in the center's outreach, such as media, public lectures and events. 
Your profile
The applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment and to be eligible, applicants must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the date of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm. 
Qualifications
PhD in business administration, psychology or a related field. Candidates with a set dissertation date may also apply.
A strong publication record in wellbeing science, including first-authored articles in leading international peer-reviewed journals
Documented expertise in language-based assessment of psychological constructs
Methodological and quantitative competence and programming in R and/or Python
Demonstrated research independence and an established international research network
Documented experience communicating research to non-academic audiences, e.g., media, public lectures or popular science

Meritorious
Experience with assessment methods beyond self-report, e.g., implicit measures or automated coding of text
Development of open research software or openly shared models
Applied collaborations with organizations or industry, e.g., in work-related wellbeing or psychometrics 

How to apply: 
Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest December 15, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application: 
A curriculum vitae 
A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings). 
Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5) 
Evidence of stakeholder engagement, for example copies or links to blogs, opinion pieces, podcasts, LinkedIn posts 
Names and contact information for two people willing to provide references. 

We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before December 15, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around April 2027. The employment is postdoctoral employment of two years.
